invariant_ordering_verified_by_code_insp: GroundingContextBuilder.build_grounding_context (grounding_context_builder.py:54-57) reads authorized_table_fqns from AuthorizationService.get_authorized_resources BEFORE retrieval — schema_retriever is called with allowed_table_fqns as an explicit filter.
SchemaRetriever.retrieve_schema_candidates (schema_retriever.py:36-46) receives allowed_table_fqns and forwards it to the search port.
InMemorySchemaSearch (schema_retriever.py:139-176) explicitly skips documents whose table_fqn is not in allowed_table_fqns (line 148).
Even relationship expansion (RelationshipExpander) receives allowed_table_fqns and filters accordingly.
Selection therefore cannot include a table just because the OpenMetadata bot can see it — the user's AuthorizationService is the gate.
